channel.title: ForkLore
channel.description: An independent tech blog on cybersecurity, AI vulnerabilities, blockchain cryptography, digital forensics and the hidden mechanics of online systems.

item.title: How the Instagram algorithm works, and how to tune it or break it
item.description: What Instagram actually ranks on, combinations of signals that reshape your feed, and how to make it so boring you finally log off.

item.title: Vibe-coded and vulnerable: prompt injection, CSRF, RCE and misconfigurations in AI-built apps
item.description: The security bugs that keep showing up in projects built with Claude and ChatGPT, why the models produce them, and how to catch them before you ship.

item.title: zk-SNARKs, Mina, and what quantum computers and AI really threaten in crypto
item.description: A tour of zero-knowledge blockchains like Mina, how SNARKs work, and which parts of cryptocurrency maths quantum computing and AI actually put at risk.

item.title: Hello, ForkLore
item.description: What this blog is for, what I'll be writing about, and how posts here are put together.
